item.title: Ask HN: How to Relicense an Old Project
item.summary: I've heard from someone who wants to revive an old abandoned project of mine and asks that I change the license from GPLv3 to LGPL or MIT. I'm willing to do that but I took down the original repo from github a long time ago and there seems to be only a fork that still exists. What's the right way to make it publicly known that I'm changing the license? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49391444 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
